hero.title: Zero-Trust Runtime for AI Agents
hero.subtitle: Lattice gives every AI agent a zero-privilege sandbox and WireGuard-encrypted network access to your infrastructure — from launch to mesh, a single command.

features.label: Capabilities
features.title: AI Agent Runtime + Network Foundation
features.subtitle: Lattice delivers two layers: the upper layer provides zero-privilege sandboxing for AI agents, and the lower layer provides WireGuard-encrypted networking for all workloads.

ai_sandbox.title: Zero-Privilege Sandbox
ai_sandbox.desc: Available in Community + PRO. `lattice sandbox start` requires no root or CAP_NET_ADMIN. gVisor pkg/tcpip replaces the kernel TUN, with full ICE/LRP identity and credential persistence across restarts.

ai_sidecar.title: Sidecar Egress Interception
ai_sidecar.desc: Dual-layer enforcement with seccomp notify + eBPF fast path. Every socket operation checks PolicyCache — allowlist hit goes through, miss returns EACCES with audit.

ai_traces.title: Tool Call Tracing + Sub-agent Delegation
ai_traces.desc: Every tool call automatically records a tool_span (traceId, agentId, duration, status). Parent agents spawn children via the Delegate API with scoped permissions; full call trees are queryable.

ai_intent.title: MCP Server + Intent Engine
ai_intent.desc: Built-in MCP Server with 14 tools — Claude, Cursor, and other AI assistants manage your network (reads execute directly, writes require approval). Intent Engine translates natural language to CRD change plans with diff preview and approval (PRO).

net_wg.title: WireGuard Encrypted Mesh
net_wg.desc: NAT-traversing P2P + LRP relay fallback. WireGuard end-to-end encryption, ICE/STUN auto hole-punching, zero-config cross-cluster bridging, built-in IPAM for automatic VPN IP allocation.

net_ebpf.title: eBPF High-Performance Policy
net_ebpf.desc: Kernel-level TC ingress/egress hooks, LPM Trie + Port Hash policy engine supporting millions of rules. Line-rate east-west traffic handling for infrastructure nodes (PRO).

net_audit.title: Full-Stack Observability
net_audit.desc: tool_spans record every MCP tool call (Community); gVisor egress flow events (flow_events) are reported to the control plane via NATS (PRO). Every allow/block can be correlated back to a tool invocation.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.title: From Sandbox Launch to Encrypted Communication
architecture.subtitle: Zero-privilege architecture: gVisor pkg/tcpip userspace netstack handles all network operations; wireguard-go performs encryption — no root required.
architecture.step_1_desc: `lattice sandbox start` generates a WireGuard keypair and completes zero-trust enrollment over NATS. The control plane creates LatticePeer + AgentIdentity, assigns a VPN IP, issues an Agent JWT, and persists credentials to /etc/lattice/.
architecture.step_2_desc: gVisor pkg/tcpip userspace netstack + TUNAdapter bridge to wireguard-go. SandboxProvisioner manages WireGuard peers with no iptables, TUN device, or kernel dependencies. PRO adds EgressFilter and ForwardListener.
architecture.step_3_desc: FilteringUDPMux multiplexes UDP :51820; ICE direct connect or LRP relay fallback. Tool calls go through CheckToolAccess RBAC, results are written to tool_spans, and parent_agent_id tracks the full call tree.
architecture.terminal_line4: → ICE P2P / LRP Relay → remote peer
